title: SREV-016 AccessCheckByType bypass shape

accesscheckbytype_shape.description: AccessCheckByType compares a security descriptor against a client token; DesiredAccess should have generic rights mapped; MAXIMUM_ALLOWED makes GrantedAccess report the maximum access rights from the security descriptor; GenericMapping->GenericAll covers all rights grantable by the resource manager; failure leaves output unset

compat_scope.description: Sandboxie keeps the BITS/WUAU compatibility bypass scope; only the reported access shape is constrained

win32_bypass_shape.description: Win32 AccessCheckByType bypass returns TRUE with AccessStatus = TRUE and GrantedAccess shaped by DesiredAccess (or GenericMapping->GenericAll for MAXIMUM_ALLOWED)

nt_bypass_shape.description: NT NtAccessCheckByType hook returns STATUS_SUCCESS with AccessStatus = STATUS_SUCCESS

runtime_matrix.description: Windows runtime gate remains open for BITS/WUAU behavior

contracts: GrantedAccess for the bypass is shaped from DesiredAccess and GenericMapping; never 0xFFFFFFFF
If DesiredAccess is MAXIMUM_ALLOWED the bypass reports GenericMapping->GenericAll plus non-maximum bits
Win32 bypass returns TRUE and AccessStatus = TRUE
NT bypass returns STATUS_SUCCESS rather than the literal TRUE
Compat scope (BITS/WUAU image set) is unchanged
